title: FBI-UAP-D014, Correspondence Relating to UFO Sightings, 1967, 1974
doc_notes: This document contains FBI correspondence regarding a 1967 civilian sighting report and an inquiry from 1974 about a 1954 UFO event.

incidents.summary: An eleven-year-old boy reported hearing a weird noise and seeing a flash of light moving north in the sky.
Alleged sighting of an occupied unidentified flying object pursued by Coast Guard personnel, which landed on the ground and was observed by civilians.
incidents.quote: alleged April 8, 1954 sighting of an occupied Unidentified Flying Object
